  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_open_for_fuzzing","line":763,"var":"data,len","code":"return config_init_data(config, data, len);","note":"The fuzz input becomes the backing storage for the configuration lexer/parser without additional validation.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"buffer contents"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_config","line":651,"var":"lexeme_ring_buffer_empty(&parser->buffer)","code":"if (!lexeme_ring_buffer_empty(&parser->buffer)) return parse_section_shorthand;","note":"A linefeed after buffered strings selects the shorthand section path, which is the vulnerable control-flow edge.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"parsed tokens"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_section_shorthand","line":620,"var":"next_state","code":"void *next_state = parse_section(parser);","note":"The shorthand handler delegates to parse_section and then emits an extra SECTION_END marker if parsing succeeds.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"control","via":"parser state"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_section","line":595,"var":"lexeme","code":"if (!lexeme_buffer_consume(&parser->buffer, &lexeme)) return NULL;","note":"The first buffered string token is consumed as the section name, and subsequent buffered strings are appended into the shared strbuf.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"buffered lexemes"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_section","line":603,"var":"parser->strbuf","code":"lwan_strbuf_append_str(&parser->strbuf, lexeme->value.value, lexeme->value.len);","note":"Each attacker-controlled token length is appended into the dynamic string buffer, growing it as needed.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"data","via":"lexeme values"}]},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-strbuf.c","function":"lwan_strbuf_append_str","line":171,"var":"s1->value.buffer + s1->used","code":"memcpy(s1->value.buffer + s1->used, s2, sz);","note":"The sink copies sz bytes from the attacker-controlled lexeme into the destination buffer; the crash is a global-buffer-overflow read when sz exceeds the available source bytes for the malformed token layout.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"data","via":"append source pointer and length"}]} 
]
